# Retro VHS

Analog warmth and archival character without sacrificing clarity.

## Use

Use for nostalgic campaigns, story introductions, and informal creative explainers.

## Essential traits

- Warm archival palette
- Subtle analog texture
- Clean foreground text

## Typography

Georgia serif headings; system monospace short metadata.

## Layout and surfaces

Framed archival feel with precise content hierarchy. Warm paper, restrained grain, subtle timestamp-like decorative labels.

## Palette

- background: #eee3c9
- surface: #fff7e5
- text: #40362f
- muted: #6e5e50
- accent: #78502e
- border: #c9b28d

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Retro VHS to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Georgia serif headings; system monospace short metadata. Framed archival feel with precise content hierarchy. Warm paper, restrained grain, subtle timestamp-like decorative labels. Palette: background #eee3c9, surface #fff7e5, text #40362f, muted #6e5e50, accent #78502e, border #c9b28d. Essential traits: Warm archival palette; Subtle analog texture; Clean foreground text. Avoid: Glitching instructions; Flicker; False timestamps presented as recorded evidence. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
